newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends slightly lower, in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends slightly lower, in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a dull session barely weaker, with prices consolidating amid dull trade, in the wake of Tuesday's volatile session, floor sources said.

The March contract opened weaker but bounced above unchanged after a light short-covering rally by the locals. Prices hovered around unchanged for the afternoon when they succumbed again to light local pressure, but the market remained within its range set early in the day.
March finished 0.03 weaker at 10.70, having ranged from 10.77 to 10.67. The back months ended 0.01 to 0.03 lower.
Prices are seen creeping lower as global supplies remain abundant. Traders pegged nearby support at 10.60 in March.
